skill.name: lark-wiki
skill.description: Manage Lark Wiki spaces, members, and nodes with lark-cli. Use it to list spaces, create wiki nodes, move content, copy nodes, and control membership.
skill.summary: Manage Lark Wiki spaces, members, nodes, and safe wiki operations from AI coding tools.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown code spans, Lark URL placeholders, and Chinese documentation entropy. Confirmed issues are cross-package Read directives, plus semantic risks from untrusted tool-use language and high-impact wiki write workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Vendor the shared guidance into this skill or declare a marketplace-managed dependency instead of using ../ paths.
Replace CRITICAL and MUST Read-tool language with a declarative dependency note that cannot override runtime instructions.

remediation.issue: High-risk wiki writes and access grants
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation for delete, move, member add, and member remove flows, especially admin grants.

content.value_statement: Teams need accurate wiki changes without guessing tokens or member types. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through lark-cli workflows for Lark Wiki.
actual_capabilities: List accessible Lark Wiki spaces and resolve personal library aliases.
Create wiki spaces and wiki nodes with user identity checks.
List, add, and remove wiki space members by supported member type.
Move or copy wiki nodes between spaces or parent nodes.
Resolve Lark Wiki URLs and tokens before write operations.
Handle async delete and move task follow-up commands.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and valid Lark authentication.
Does not edit document, sheet, or Base content.
Does not upload files into wiki nodes.
Destructive actions still need explicit user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Organize team knowledge spaces
use_cases.description: Review spaces, inspect node trees, and move wiki pages into the correct structure.

use_cases.title: Manage wiki access
use_cases.description: Add, remove, and audit wiki members with the correct member type and role.

use_cases.title: Prepare documentation structures
use_cases.description: Create spaces and starter nodes for projects, onboarding, and team knowledge bases.

prompt_templates.title: List my wiki spaces
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Lark Wiki spaces I can access as user. Show names, space IDs, and visibility.

prompt_templates.title: Create a team wiki space
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark Wiki space named <space name> with description <description>. Use user identity and show the result.

prompt_templates.title: Add a wiki member
prompt_templates.prompt: Add <person or group> to <space name or ID> as <member or admin>. Resolve the member ID first and show what will change.

prompt_templates.title: Reorganize wiki nodes safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the node tree for <space or wiki URL>, propose a move plan, ask for confirmation, then move selected nodes.

output: Found three accessible spaces with names and space IDs.
The personal library needs a separate my_library lookup if required.

output_examples.input: Move this page under the onboarding wiki node.
output_examples.output: The skill resolves the source node, checks the target parent node, asks for confirmation, and performs the move.

output_examples.input: Add Ana as a wiki admin.
output_examples.output: The skill searches for Ana, confirms the target space and role, then grants admin access after approval.

best_practices: Use user identity for personal or user-owned wiki resources.
Resolve URLs to node tokens or space IDs before write operations.
Show candidates before deleting spaces or moving nodes.
anti_patterns: Do not pass a wiki URL directly as a space ID.
Do not retry invalid parameters without fixing the token or permission.
Do not add department members with bot identity.

faq.question: Does this skill need lark-cli?
faq.answer: Yes. It depends on lark-cli and an authenticated Lark account.

faq.question: Can it edit page content?
faq.answer: No. It manages wiki spaces, nodes, and members. Document content belongs to separate document skills.

faq.question: Can it delete a wiki space?
faq.answer: Yes, but deletion requires explicit confirmation and the safety confirmation flag.

faq.question: Can it use bot identity?
faq.answer: Some operations support bot identity. Personal libraries and department member adds require user identity.

faq.question: What tools support it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How does it handle wiki URLs?
faq.answer: It resolves wiki URLs to tokens and space IDs before using write commands.
